methods.label: Apply the definition from the inside out
methods.explanation:
The parentheses tell us to evaluate \(1\star2\) first. Substituting the ordered pair \((1,2)\) into the definition gives
\[
1\star2=\frac{1+2}{1-2}=\frac{3}{-1}=-3.
\]
Now use \(-3\) as the first input and \(3\) as the second:
\[
(-3)\star3=\frac{-3+3}{-3-3}=\frac{0}{-6}=0.
\]
The denominators are \(-1\) and \(-6\), so both operations are defined. The value is \(\boxed{0}\), choice C.
